integrity: The proof instantiates the source finite-world bound, preserves that world set through the non-standard-to-standard transfer, uses the source value-compression endpoint, and independently accounts for the bit size and deterministic verification cost of a guessed standard model.
scientific_limitations: This is an upper-bound theorem for the announcement-free successor knowing-value logic. It does not determine exact complexity, does not cover succinct binary-coded successor exponents, and does not analyze public-announcement elimination blow-up.
title: Successor knowing-value satisfiability has singly-exponential certificates
